title: Shaft speed ambiguous — audio track conflicts with Bayesian posterior
summary: Scale-invariant speed posterior MAP 198.0 rpm (3.30 Hz), 68% CI 197.4–198.3 rpm, but p_map=0.389 <0.80 with competing modes 209.0 rpm p=0.256, 222.2 rpm p=0.214, 187.1 rpm p=0.141; 18/18 peaks explained. Audio blade-pass track instead gives 12.41 Hz / 744.6 rpm, sweep 3.8%, speeding_up. What-if tests did not resolve it: induction_motor 4-pole MAP 198.0 rpm p_map=0.400, fan 4-blade MAP 197.7 rpm p_map=0.487. No display_rpm for an independent check. Do not treat any single rpm as certain; need tachometer/nameplate/display capture and blade/vane count.

title: Resonance possible — moderate, wide-uncertainty posterior, no Campbell critical confirmed
summary: Resonance fault posterior P=0.519, range 0.213–0.712 (prior 0.12), evaluable, from forcing-to-mode separation 0.006 (+12.6 dB). FDD structural modes: 2.93 Hz zeta=5.4% sv_ratio 18.9, 5.74 Hz zeta=3.8% sv_ratio 12.0, 6.56 Hz zeta=2.6% sv_ratio 6.9, and 2.11 Hz zeta unknown sv_ratio 8.6; residual peak 2.34±0.23 Hz, zeta unknown. However campbell_criticals=[] and speed is ambiguous, so a forcing line crossing a natural frequency in operation is NOT confirmed. Needs controlled run-up/coast-down with tach vs these modes.

title: Amplitude scale uncalibrated — no ISO 20816 zone or absolute mm/s severity
summary: scale_calibrated=false; overall iso_zone=null despite channel RMS values 1778, 1643 and 1803 (units nominal mm/s) which are physically implausible. Per scale note, amplitudes are relative only. Conclusions therefore rest on frequencies, orders, phase and ratios, not absolute mm/s. Order amplitudes at the 12.41 Hz audio track are 1x=15.29 relative, 2x=0, 3x=0, but the shaft definition is ambiguous so this cannot be labelled 1x-shaft imbalance. Recapture with a credible scale reference / fixed camera.

title: Cavitation and looseness not supported by measured evidence
summary: Cavitation: P=0.034, index 0.237 (-3.9 dB), HF energy fraction 0.059, HF kurtosis -0.07, audio cavitation_like=false. Looseness: P=0.004, shaft harmonics 1-10x above 10 dB = 0 (-8.7 dB), half-order lines 3.6 dB (-4.3 dB) — no many-harmonics looseness signature. No cavitation or looseness action justified on this capture.

title: Imbalance, misalignment and other shaft faults not evaluable
summary: Fault posterior evaluable=false for imbalance P=0.15 (prior only), misalignment P=0.10, flow P=0.10, combustion P=0.10, bearing P=0.08, rotor_bar P=0.05 — no evidence in decibans. Therefore 1x-dominant-radial imbalance, 2x with ~180 deg phase across coupling for misalignment, and bearing/electrical rules cannot be applied. Needed capture: tach-synced radial+axial vibration at both bearings with cross-coupling phase, confirmed shaft rpm, machine class/blades/poles/nameplate, and higher sampling if bearing tones are sought.

title: Near-Nyquist capture limits high-frequency confidence
summary: fps=30.0, Nyquist=15.0 Hz, near_nyquist_warning=true; audio speed track 12.41 Hz is 83% of Nyquist. Lines near Nyquist may be aliased/attenuated, so high-frequency and blade-pass interpretation is weak. Structural modes reported are below 6.6 Hz, but a better capture (higher fps / accelerometer, longer steady-speed record) is required before concluding on high-frequency faults.

# WO-261104-65DF3 · Motor M-1

**Priority:** P2 (within 7 days)  
**Failure mode:** VIB – Vibration (ISO 14224)  
**Suspected cause:** Forcing frequency coincident with a structural natural frequency (posterior 0.52)  
**Raised by:** muse-wonder-1.0 · 2026-11-04 10:20

Do NOT change setpoint or balance yet. Fit tachometer and record steady-speed plus controlled run-up/coast-down vibration (radial+axial, both bearings, cross-coupling phase), confirm nameplate/machine class/blades/poles and view any rpm display, and re-shoot with calibrated scale and higher sampling. Check response near FDD modes 2.93 Hz (zeta 5.4%), 5.74 Hz (3.8%), 6.56 Hz (2.6%) and residual 2.34 Hz, and avoid sustained dwelling in 126.6–154.7 rpm until cleared.

## Evidence
- forcing-to-mode separation = 0.006 (+12.6 dB)
- Amplitudes uncalibrated: severity from frequencies and ratios
- Running speed 745 rpm (audio (blade pass))

## Safety
- Lock out / tag out (LOTO) the drive and isolate process energy
- Guards back on before restart; no loose clothing near rotating parts

## Tasks
1. Program VFD skip frequencies over the resonance bands (Argonaut can do this).
2. If the duty needs that speed: detune the structure. To move fn above the forcing by 15 %, stiffness must rise by the factor computed below (mass unchanged). Here: fn = 2.34 Hz, 1x = 12.41 Hz -> stiffness x37.08 (fn ∝ √k).
3. Re-run a coast-down; confirm the Campbell crossing has moved out of the operating range.

## Parts
- Bracing / stiffener per detuning calculation

**Estimated time:** 1.0 h

## Verification
Re-measure with Argonaut after the work; acceptance: fault posterior < 0.2 and ISO zone A/B (or unchanged frequencies/ratios if uncalibrated).

text:
## Assessment — inconclusive speed, possible resonance

**Speed identity is not resolved.**  
- Audio blade-pass track: **12.41 Hz / 744.6 rpm**, reported as *speeding up* with **3.8%** sweep.  
- Bayesian speed posterior: MAP **198.0 rpm / 3.30 Hz**, 68% CI **197.4–198.3 rpm**, but **p_map = 0.389** (<0.80), with competing modes at **209.0 rpm (p=0.256)**, **222.2 rpm (p=0.214)** and **187.1 rpm (p=0.141)**. What-if tests did not resolve it: 4-pole induction motor **p_map=0.400**, 4-blade fan **p_map=0.487**. No `display_rpm` was captured, so no independent display error can be reported.

**Resonance is the leading evaluable hypothesis, but not confirmed.**  
- Fault posterior: **P=0.519**, wide range **0.213–0.712**, from forcing-to-mode separation **0.006 (+12.6 dB)**.  
- FDD structural modes: **2.93 Hz, ζ=5.4%**; **5.74 Hz, ζ=3.8%**; **6.56 Hz, ζ=2.6%**; plus **2.11 Hz** with ζ unknown and a residual peak at **2.34 ± 0.23 Hz**.  
- However, `campbell_criticals=[]`, so a forcing line crossing a natural frequency during operation is **not proven**.

**Severity cannot be stated in absolute mm/s or ISO 20816 zones.**  
`scale_calibrated=false` and overall `iso_zone=null`; amplitudes are **relative only**. No ISO zone or absolute mm/s severity is therefore reported. The near-Nyquist condition also weakens high-frequency confidence: Nyquist **15.0 Hz**, audio track **12.41 Hz**.

**Not supported:** cavitation **P=0.034** (index **0.237**, audio `cavitation_like=false`) and looseness **P=0.004** (0 shaft harmonics 1–10× above 10 dB).  
**Not evaluable:** imbalance, misalignment, blade/vane-pass flow, bearing, combustion and rotor-bar faults returned `evaluable:false`; those require tach-synced radial/axial measurements, cross-coupling phase, confirmed machine class/blades/poles and nameplate data.

## Optimisation

`run_optimiser(duty_min_frac=0.80, resonance_margin=0.10)` returned **feasible=false** — “no speed satisfies duty, resonance and severity constraints”.  
Exclusion band: **126.6–154.7 rpm**; feasible band: none. **No setpoint was proposed and no energy impact was calculated**, because shaft speed and absolute vibration severity are unverified.

## Actions queued

- **Skip bands:** proposed **126.6–154.7 rpm**, but status is `needs_drive` — no drive is connected, so this was included as a work-order step rather than programmed.
- **Work order WO-261104-65DF3 (P2, within 7 days)** for resonance verification: fit a tachometer, capture nameplate/machine class/blades/poles and any rpm display, record steady-speed plus controlled run-up/coast-down data, and re-shoot with calibrated scale and higher sampling. Do **not** balance or change setpoint yet.
- **Follow-up:** re-measurement due **2026-12-04**.

A better capture is required before concluding: tach confirmation plus calibrated, higher-rate vibration data would resolve the speed posterior, test the Campbell crossing against the 2.93/5.74/6.56 Hz modes, and make imbalance/misalignment evaluable.
